build_Patchify_module: build a PyTorch module that projects images into patch tokens using a strided convolution
build_PatchifyPS_module: build a PyTorch module that maps images to patch tokens using PixelUnshuffle and LayerNorm2d
build_Unpatchify_module: build a PyTorch module that reconstructs images from patch tokens with adaLN modulation and linear projection
build_UnpatchifyPS_module: build a PyTorch module that reconstructs images from patch tokens using PixelShuffle and LayerNorm2d
test_patchify_unpatchify_roundtrip: test the PatchifyPS and UnpatchifyPS modules by running a forward pass and checking output shapes
